channel.title: Disclosure
channel.desc: The agonising journey of Cole Cooper's family as they fight to discover what happened to him. Nineteen-year-old Cole went missing in May. Five weeks later, his body was found in woods. Police ruled his death 'unexplained'. Sam Poling investigates Cole's final hours and reveals disturbing failings in the police response - not only in his case, but in the deaths of other young men who went missing.
